item.title: test(gateway): capture session-store forensics on adoption flake (#12…
item.summary: test(gateway): capture session-store forensics on adoption flake (#122718) The concurrent keyed sessions.create adoption assertion flaked once on CI (run 31609081812) with the persisted row missing while all 16 creates succeeded. Owner-path analysis (fenced create path, direct SQL read, post-commit publication, async tails, sqlite target resolution) found no reachable mechanism and the failure never reproduced locally (11 runs). On mismatch the assertion now reports the case dir's sqlite files, the resolved target path, and raw session_nodes rows so the next occurrence identifies the writer/reader split instead of printing undefined.
